entities.name: Mastercard
entities.description: Advertiser partner activating brand and merchant advertising across iHeart destinations powered by Genuin. Owns the DSP, user graph, audience segments, and uploads video creative via BCC.

entities.name: iHeart
entities.description: Publisher whose web destinations carry the Genuin SDK and host the Mastercard ad placements covered by the integration guide.

entities.name: Koah
entities.description: Partner that powers LLM-native conversational ad delivery inside the AI overlay, generating contextual prompts and selecting/serving Mastercard ad units.

entities.name: LiveRamp
entities.description: Recommended identity resolution partner that maps Genuin pseudonymous IDs to Mastercard's user graph for audience targeting and closed-loop measurement.

entities.name: Aniview
entities.description: Ad server that fulfils all programmatic in-feed and in-stream placements; supports VAST tags, PMP/PG deal IDs, and oRTB bidding paths from Mastercard's DSP.

entities.name: ID5
entities.description: Alternative open, privacy-first identity solution offering strong cookieless reach on web inventory if LiveRamp is not the preferred path.

entities.name: UID 2.0
entities.description: Email-based pseudonymous identifier from The Trade Desk, widely adopted across programmatic supply chains, listed as an alternative identity option.

entities.name: The Trade Desk
entities.description: Demand-side platform vendor that maintains the UID 2.0 identity solution referenced as an alternative to LiveRamp.

entities.name: Lotame
entities.description: Data collaboration platform with cross-device graph capabilities, listed as an alternative identity partner.

entities.name: Epsilon
entities.description: First-party data network with strong retail and commerce media applications, listed as an alternative identity partner.

entities.name: Google IMA SDK
entities.description: Rendering SDK used to serve Programmatic In-Feed Video placements via Aniview.

entities.name: GPT.js
entities.description: Google Publisher Tag library used to render Programmatic In-Feed Native and Display placements served through Aniview.

entities.name: VAST
entities.description: Video ad serving standard (versions 2.0, 3.0, 4.0) used for in-feed video and in-stream linear video ad requests and click tracking.

entities.name: VMAP
entities.description: Playlist standard supported for in-stream break scheduling (one ad per pre/mid/post break; ad podding not supported).

entities.name: VPAID
entities.description: Optional interactive video ad standard supported as JS creatives for in-stream linear placements.

entities.name: oRTB
entities.description: Real-time bidding protocol used by Mastercard's DSP to connect to Aniview and bid on iHeart inventory in real time.

entities.name: Genuin SDK
entities.description: JavaScript snippet embedded on iHeart destinations that requests the video feed from the Genuin backend and renders the video carousel with in-feed ad slots.

entities.name: Genuin Video Infrastructure
entities.description: Backend that assembles and serves the video feed for Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post placements where Mastercard uploads creative.

entities.name: Genuin Backend Feed Service
entities.description: Server that receives feed requests from the SDK, resolves identity and targeting (including BYOA invocation), assembles video posts plus ad placements, and returns the feed.

entities.name: Octo GPT
entities.description: AI-powered conversational chat overlay embedded on top of the Genuin video feed; triggered by a configurable dwell period and used to host Koah-served LLM ads.

entities.name: Genuin BCC
entities.description: Brand console where Mastercard uploads sponsored video creative, configures audience and creative mapping, sets Pixel event triggers, and accesses dashboards and reports.

entities.name: Genuin Pixel
entities.description: Lightweight JavaScript tag placed on Mastercard merchant and conversion pages that attributes Genuin ad impressions to downstream view-through conversion events.

entities.name: Genuin Catalog API
entities.description: Paginated REST endpoint at api.genuin.com/v1/catalog/videos that exposes active Mastercard video assets with video_id, metadata, and status for BYOA model syncing.

entities.name: BCC Upload Registration
entities.description: Mechanism where each video uploaded to BCC receives a unique video_id in the upload response that Mastercard records in its CMS for BYOA references.

entities.name: BYOA
entities.description: Server-side endpoint pattern where Genuin sends a real-time context payload at slot-fill time and Mastercard's algorithm responds with the video_id(s) to serve, enabling per-user creative personalisation.

entities.name: Genuin Out-of-the-Box Targeting
entities.description: Default targeting system that uses LiveRamp-resolved audience segments to match users to the appropriate Sponsored Takeover or Post creative from the uploaded library.

entities.name: Sponsored Content Mechanism
entities.description: Direct-sold buying mechanism in which Genuin's video infrastructure serves Mastercard-uploaded brand video; covers Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post formats.

entities.name: Programmatic Channels Mechanism
entities.description: Buying mechanism in which Mastercard's DSP serves ad creatives in real time via Aniview, controlling both creative selection and audience targeting.

entities.name: Sponsored Takeover
entities.description: Highest-impact in-feed placement that converts the first N slots of the video feed into a continuous Mastercard-sponsored experience, served by Genuin's video infrastructure.

entities.name: Sponsored Post
entities.description: Individual in-feed card with Mastercard-branded video served by Genuin's video infrastructure at calculated frequency-based ad slot positions interleaved with organic content.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Video
entities.description: In-feed video card with a CTA bar replacing engagement icons; served by Mastercard's DSP through Google IMA SDK and Aniview, with VAST/VMAP support.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Native
entities.description: Static native card (headline, image, brand, description, CTA) blending with the feed, served via GPT.js and Aniview with DSP-controlled targeting and creative.

entities.name: Programmatic In-Feed Display
entities.description: Standard display banner (image or HTML5) rendered as a feed card via GPT.js and Aniview; recommended sizes include 300x250 or vertical mobile equivalents.

entities.name: Pre-roll Ad
entities.description: Linear video ad that plays before the organic content video; ad request sent at content start within the Genuin video carousel player.

entities.name: Mid-roll Ad
entities.description: Linear video ad that interrupts content at the midpoint, prefetched ~10–12 seconds before the break using Genuin's non-blocking prefetch model.

entities.name: Post-roll Ad
entities.description: Linear video ad that plays after the organic content video completes, prefetched ~10 seconds before content ends.

entities.name: LLM Ads
entities.description: Native conversational ad placements served within the AI-powered Octo GPT overlay on top of the video player, activated through Genuin's partnership with Koah.

entities.name: Action Card
entities.description: Koah card-format unit with one or more configurable CTA buttons (e.g., Apply Now, Get Offer) and destination URL, designed to drive direct user action from within the conversation.

entities.name: Image Card
entities.description: Koah visually-led card featuring a brand image, headline, and optional description; suited to brand awareness and visual storytelling within the conversational context.

entities.name: Poll Ad
entities.description: Koah interactive poll embedded in the LLM conversation where users select from pre-defined options, generating audience insight and engagement signals.

entities.name: Expandable Ad
entities.description: Koah compact teaser unit that expands on tap to reveal full ad content, allowing richer creative without disrupting conversation flow.

entities.name: VAST Ad Tags Path
entities.description: Aniview integration path where Mastercard provides a VAST tag or ad tag URL configured as a demand source; simplest activation ideal for existing ad-server tags.

entities.name: PMP / Programmatic Guaranteed
entities.description: Recommended Aniview integration path where Mastercard creates PMP or PG deals in its DSP and the deal IDs transact at negotiated CPM against prioritised iHeart inventory.

entities.name: DSP oRTB Bidding Path
entities.description: Aniview integration path where Mastercard's DSP connects via an oRTB endpoint, receives real-time bid requests for iHeart inventory, and responds with bids.

entities.name: Context Attribution
entities.description: Attribution layer that tracks the video content a user consumed immediately before viewing a sponsored placement, surfaced as a contextual performance report in BCC.

entities.name: View Attribution
entities.description: Attribution layer delivered via the Genuin Pixel that links ad impressions to downstream user actions on Mastercard properties within a configured view-through window.

entities.name: Out-of-the-Box Metrics
entities.description: Baseline performance metrics available by default for all ad formats and accessible via the Genuin BCC dashboard and API export.

entities.name: Mastercard User Graph
entities.description: Mastercard's identity graph onto which Genuin's pseudonymous user identifiers are mapped via LiveRamp to enable audience-level targeting and closed-loop measurement.

entities.name: Mastercard Audience Segments
entities.description: Audience segments (e.g., merchant category, spend behaviour, geography) that Mastercard pushes into Genuin to power out-of-the-box targeting and feed context into BYOA.

entities.name: iHeart Inventory
entities.description: The advertising inventory across iHeart destinations that Mastercard transacts against via Aniview through VAST tags, PMP/PG deals, or oRTB bidding.

entities.name: Mastercard Merchant Pages
entities.description: Mastercard merchant and conversion-destination web pages onto which the Genuin Pixel is placed to capture view-through conversion events.

relationships.description: Mastercard activates brand and merchant advertising across iHeart destinations via the Genuin-powered integration.
The Genuin SDK is embedded on iHeart's web destination as a JavaScript snippet.
Once initialised the SDK sends a feed request to the Genuin backend including page context and user identity signals.
The backend assembles video posts served by Genuin's video infrastructure for Sponsored Takeover and Sponsored Post placements.
Sponsored Takeover is a direct-sold Mechanism 1 placement served by Genuin's video infrastructure.
Sponsored Post is a direct-sold Mechanism 1 placement served by Genuin's video infrastructure.
Programmatic In-Feed Video is a Mechanism 2 placement served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
Programmatic In-Feed Native is a Mechanism 2 placement served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
Programmatic In-Feed Display is a Mechanism 2 placement served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
In-stream pre-roll is a Mechanism 2 placement where Mastercard's DSP serves the linear video creative via Aniview.
In-stream mid-roll is a Mechanism 2 placement where Mastercard's DSP serves the linear video creative via Aniview.
In-stream post-roll is a Mechanism 2 placement where Mastercard's DSP serves the linear video creative via Aniview.
All N takeover positions are served by Genuin's video infrastructure from Mastercard-uploaded video.
Sponsored Posts are served by Genuin's video infrastructure at calculated ad-slot positions.
Sponsored Takeover is sold direct with content uploaded via Genuin BCC.
Sponsored Post is sold direct with content uploaded via Genuin BCC.
Sponsored Takeover supports advanced per-user creative personalisation via Mastercard's own algorithm through BYOA.
Sponsored Post supports advanced per-user creative personalisation via Mastercard's own algorithm through BYOA.
Sponsored Takeover can be targeted by Genuin's out-of-the-box targeting using LiveRamp-resolved segments.
Sponsored Post can be targeted by Genuin's out-of-the-box targeting using LiveRamp-resolved segments.
Programmatic in-feed video is fulfilled by the Aniview ad server.
Programmatic in-feed video is rendered via the Google IMA SDK with VAST/VMAP requests.
Programmatic in-feed native creatives are served through Aniview.
Programmatic in-feed native creatives are rendered using GPT.js (Google Publisher Tag).
Programmatic in-feed display banners are served via Aniview.
Programmatic in-feed display banners are rendered using GPT.js.
In-stream pre-roll creatives are served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
In-stream mid-roll creatives are served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
In-stream post-roll creatives are served by Mastercard's DSP via Aniview.
Programmatic in-feed video requests are made via VAST URLs (versions 2.0, 3.0, 4.0).
In-stream linear ads use VAST 2.0/3.0/4.0 for ad requests and click tracking.
In-stream linear ads use VAST 2.0/3.0/4.0 for ad requests and click tracking.
In-stream linear ads use VAST 2.0/3.0/4.0 for ad requests and click tracking.
Pre-roll breaks are scheduled via VMAP with one ad per break.
Mid-roll breaks are scheduled via VMAP with one ad per break.
Post-roll breaks are scheduled via VMAP with one ad per break.
VPAID JS creatives are optionally supported for in-stream linear placements.
Path A configures a Mastercard-provided VAST tag URL directly as a demand source in Aniview.
Path B accepts PMP or Programmatic Guaranteed deal IDs created in Mastercard's DSP, the recommended starting point for guaranteed delivery.
Path C connects Mastercard's DSP to Aniview via oRTB for real-time bidding on iHeart inventory.
Path C uses an OpenRTB endpoint for real-time bid requests and responses.
PMP/PG deal IDs transact at a negotiated CPM against guaranteed or prioritised allocations of iHeart inventory.
The Octo GPT overlay is embedded on top of the Genuin video feed delivered by the SDK.
The Octo GPT overlay hosts the AI-generated prompt and the Mastercard ad unit served by Koah.
LLM ads are activated through Genuin's partnership with Koah, which generates prompts and serves Mastercard ad units in real time.
Action Card is one of the four Koah ad formats available within the LLM overlay.
Image Card is one of the four Koah ad formats available within the LLM overlay.
Poll is one of the four Koah ad formats available within the LLM overlay.
Expandable is one of the four Koah ad formats available within the LLM overlay.
Mastercard's LiveRamp-resolved identity segments can optionally be passed to Koah for audience-level targeting within the overlay.
BYOA depends on a shared video_id reference; the Catalog API lets Mastercard sync active video assets to keep its algorithm current.
BYOA also relies on capturing the video_id returned in the BCC upload response for each Mastercard video.
BCC Upload Registration is part of the existing Genuin BCC upload workflow.
The Catalog API exposes the active Mastercard video catalog managed through BCC.
LiveRamp maps Genuin pseudonymous user identifiers to Mastercard's user graph for audience targeting and closed-loop measurement.
The user graph used for identity mapping is owned by Mastercard.
Audience segments such as merchant category, spend behaviour, and geography are owned by Mastercard and pushed into Genuin.
Genuin's OOB targeting uses LiveRamp-resolved Mastercard audience segments to match users to the appropriate Sponsored placement.
Mastercard audience segments are available as context signals to the BYOA endpoint at slot-fill time.
Sponsored Takeover is served to users belonging to configured Mastercard audience segments.
Sponsored Post is served to users belonging to configured Mastercard audience segments.
The Pixel is placed as a JavaScript snippet on Mastercard merchant and conversion destination pages.
View-through attribution is delivered by the Genuin Pixel tagged on Mastercard pages.
Conversion event triggers and attributed reports for the Pixel are configured and accessed in BCC.
Context Attribution data is surfaced in BCC as a contextual performance report.
OOB metrics are accessible via the Genuin BCC dashboard and API export.
ID5 is offered as an alternative identity partner if LiveRamp is not the preferred resolution path.
UID 2.0 is offered as an alternative email-based pseudonymous ID if LiveRamp is not the preferred path.
UID 2.0 is the identity solution maintained by The Trade Desk.
Lotame is offered as an alternative identity partner with cross-device graph capabilities.
Epsilon is offered as an alternative first-party data network identity partner.
Mastercard pushes audience segments and receives engagement signals through a LiveRamp data collaboration agreement.
Genuin shares pseudonymous user identifiers with LiveRamp under a secure data collaboration agreement covering iHeart inventory.
